title: 5 mistakes beginners make with AI tools

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know 70% of AI tools fail because of these beginner mistakes?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AI is changing jobs, marketing, and even healthcare — fast.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Using AI without understanding basics leads to bad results.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Most beginners ignore training data — it shapes your AI's personality.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Marketers who skip this end up with biased or irrelevant content.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Always check where your AI's knowledge comes from — it's critical.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What’s the first mistake you’ve made with AI? Let me know.
